payload.body: examiner: writing fleet/tests/test_run_engine_state_exams.mjs as a pure in-process sim — no child processes, no sibling sim names. Legs map: (a) M1 the eight keys and the three walls shapes; (b) M2 the pre-#834 shape, a missing walls.json and an unparsable one; (c) M3 stateExamBlock unchanged; (d) M4 the two schema lines, the eight-key prose and no 'six keys' in the engine. Expected red at BASE because the engine drops action_ms/browser and the doc lists six keys.

payload.body:
Done and committed. Footprint is exactly skills/ultrawrite/references/greenfield-stack.md (+84/-2); the only deletion is the two-line TINYAPP_RENDER_URL sentence, so '## The engine boundary' and '## The baseline rule' are byte-identical and the guarded engine/role/kernel paths are untouched. All six Proof legs run green in-tree.

One decision a later session would otherwise rediscover: the two fixture ts blocks were placed after the 'Seeding is the plan's own work' paragraph rather than immediately after the callback-form block, so the three paragraphs that explain the callback block (import depth, view vocabulary, seeding) stay adjacent to it. M1 only requires the block to come after the callback-form block, which it does. The interaction prose then runs in M2 -> M3 -> M4 order and #999's lint:state sentence is the section's final paragraph.
